entries.title: Psalms 135:1
segments: Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; praise Him, servants of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 135:2
segments: [Those] who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

entries.title: Psalms 135:3
segments: praise the LORD; for the LORD [is] good; sing praises to His name, for [it is] full of delight.

entries.title: Psalms 135:4
segments: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to Himself, [and] Israel for His peculiar treasure.

entries.title: Psalms 135:5
segments: For I know that the LORD [is] great, and our LORD [is] above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 135:6
segments: Every thing the LORD pleased, He did in the heavens and in earth, and in the seas and all deep places.

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
segments: He causes the vapors to rise from the end of the earth; He makes lightnings for the rain; He brings wind out of His storehouses.

entries.title: Psalms 135:8
segments: [He] who struck the first-born of Egypt, both of man and animal;

entries.title: Psalms 135:9
segments: [who] sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, on Pharaoh and on all his servants;

entries.title: Psalms 135:10
segments: who struck great nations and killed mighty kings,

entries.title: Psalms 135:11
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,

entries.title: Psalms 135:12
segments: and gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.

entries.title: Psalms 135:13
segments: Your name, O LORD, [endures] forever, and Your memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 135:14
segments: For the LORD will judge His people, and He will have pity on His servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:15
segments: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 135:16
segments: They [have] mouths, but they do not speak; they [have] eyes, but they do not see;

entries.title: Psalms 135:17
segments: they [have] ears, but they do not hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

entries.title: Psalms 135:18
segments: Those who make them are like them, everyone who trusts in them.

entries.title: Psalms 135:19
segments: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel; bless the LORD, O house of Aaron;

entries.title: Psalms 135:20
segments: bless the LORD, O house of Levi; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 135:21
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD out of Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
